_note: League-independent seed data for league_service.create_league (phase-0-foundation.md §7.2, Decision 8). Real 2025-26 NBA CBA figures, sourced 2026-08-23 from Hoops Rumors' 2025-26 cap/tax/apron reporting and official NBA PR salary-cap memos. This block is loaded once per league_service.create_league call and written as that league's league_cap_settings row for current_season -- it is a single 'current' constants block, not a multi-year history table; a league created next year picks up an updated file, not a migration (§7.2). max_pct_*/supermax_pct and raise_pct_bird/raise_pct_non_bird are stable CBA rules (not season-specific), included here anyway since league_cap_settings is a per-season row and every column is NOT NULL. min_salary is the approximate 2025-26 rookie/0-years-of-service minimum -- a single scalar can't express the real sliding veteran-minimum scale by years of service, consistent with rookie_scale's own '2024-25 approximation' framing (migration 003) elsewhere in this simplified-but-real model (§10 open question 2). mle_amount is the non-taxpayer MLE.
